consequence.statement: New optional capability: Service API calls can now carry custom headers. The evidence describes no impact on existing configurations.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds a headers field to apiCall.service in policy context entries, so Kyverno Service API calls can send custom HTTP request headers, such as an Authorization token.
